name: Subspace — Filter Companies by Quality Score

nodes.name: Sample Domain List
nodes.notes: Replace this Code node with whatever produces your domain list — a Google Sheets read, a Clay webhook, an Apollo export, an HTTP request, etc. Each item must have a `domain` field.

nodes.name: Subspace — Enrich
nodes.notes: Subspace runs once per input item, automatically. 60 req/min during beta — chain a Wait node before this if your list is large.

nodes.name: Quality Score >= 60
nodes.notes:
Tweak the threshold or swap the field. Common alternatives:
- ghost_job_rate <= 30 (skip ghost-heavy companies)
- hiring_actively == true (only actively-hiring)
- it_infrastructure_tier == 'Enterprise' (target enterprise stack)
